summary: Phase A (skeleton template authority) fully verified. Backend: 25/25 pytest cases green — new detailed validation matrix (8 scenarios: clean, duplicates, orphan, two-roots, missing bones, missing landmark targets, L without R, non-unit quaternion), templates CRUD with sha256 upsert (idempotency confirmed, list omits template_data, DELETE→404, empty bones→400), project.template persistence with source='user_authoritative'. Frontend: initial sample_dev badge + meta (Quinn-like Sample (DEV), 71 bones, NOT RUN), Validate → warning with provenance WARN, FBX binary import → user_authoritative badge, 9 bones, name=test_skeleton_binary, version=fbx-7400, INVALID pill with landmark_targets FAIL, Template tab shows provenance (FBX 7400, creator, sha256), units block (cm, +Y, ×0.01 conv), parser report (0 errors, mesh SKM_TestMesh ignored), diag root=root, bone-count=9. Bones tab lists all 9 expected bones; inspector on spine_01 shows correct verbatim values (0.1080, 5.00, 1.0755, 10.800, 10.000) and parent-link nav → pelvis. Export triggers 'test_skeleton_binary.template.json' download. Reset returns sample_dev + 71 bones. Diagnostics tab template-authority WARN, ready-for-auto-fit WARN with 'Blocked' text. Project save + full page reload + load restores user_authoritative + 9 bones. Library select shows imported FBX. No console errors.

critical_code_review_comments: validate_template_structure is ~170 lines in server.py — consider extracting to /app/backend/validators/template.py; server.py is now 509 lines and will exceed the 700-line advisory after Phase B (skinning).

SavedTemplate upsert branch preserves existing id/created_at but overwrites `validation` field silently — fine but worth documenting so callers know last-writer-wins for validation metadata on same sha256.

Diagnostic check rows (diag-check-template-authority, diag-check-ready-for-auto-fit) embed WARN/PASS as text but do not expose a data-status attribute like validation-check-<id> does. For consistency with automated tests, add data-status on the DiagnosticsTab check rows too.

Frontend toggles viewport-skeleton-toggle / viewport-bone-axes-toggle are inside BonesTab.jsx only — if UX expects them always visible in the viewport, hoist them; if intentional (bones-tab context), fine.
Consider 204 No Content on DELETE /api/templates/{id} and /api/projects/{id} for REST convention (currently returns 200 {ok:true}).
